headline: Keep your FPL weekly check to about 15 minutes, and make a small, safe change only if you need one.

points.text: One creator is pushing a 15-minute-style weekly routine with small transfers, not big changes. Several videos cover Gameweek 11 transfer ideas.
points.label: opinion

points.text: A creator suggests considering whether to sell Haaland, and calls it a question people are asking.
points.label: opinion

points.text: A creator says one transfer is already made and shares early Gameweek 11 thoughts. Treat this as one person's choice, not a rule.
points.label: opinion

points.text: A creator compares Free Hit timing across several weeks. There is no clear answer given, so don't rush to use the chip.
points.label: opinion

points.text: A creator reacts to Gameweek 10 results and looks ahead to Gameweek 11. Use recent results to guide your weekly check.
points.label: opinion

differences.text: Videos split on whether to keep or sell Manchester United attackers, and on whether Haaland should be sold. No clear agreement across sources.
